item.title: Combiner 0.27.0
item.description:
• Recent rooms is now a button next to the room code: click it, then click a room to switch. Going back is one more click.
  • Leave has moved into the room menu (click the room code), just above Reset room. While you're offline it reads Rejoin room.
  • One Sort menu replaces the Tracks / Latest switch: DAW Order shows each song with its tracks, and every other order (Newest, Oldest, A–Z, Longest, Type) is one list.
  • The relay address is no longer a setting.
  • Disk space to keep free is now 2, 5 or 10 GB (2 GB by default), and a Low disk space card shows at launch when under 15 GB is free.
